brief.headline: Musk plans SpaceX share for every American child
brief.detail: SpaceX boss Elon Musk said Monday he will give one of his company shares to every U.S. child next year, without saying how it would work.

brief.headline: Silgan and American Industrial Partners to buy Trivium Packaging
brief.detail: Silgan and American Industrial Partners agreed to acquire Trivium Packaging in a deal valued at about $3.4 billion.

brief.headline: Anthropic seen as last major AI IPO this year
brief.detail: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut, and others have postponed too.

brief.headline: AI stocks bounce back after bruising selloff
brief.detail: AI stocks rebounded after a bruising selloff, and Goldman Sachs upgraded CoreWeave, according to Reuters.

brief.headline: China's third-quarter economic growth accelerates to 4.5%
brief.detail: China's economic growth accelerated to 4.5% in the third quarter, a data point covered by five outlets.
